newsitem.title: SPAIN: Amper nine-month results soar 48 percent.
newsitem.headline: Amper nine-month results soar 48 percent.

text.p: Results for first nine months in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

NOTE- The Amper Group said foreign sales represented 32 percent of group sales, up from 25 percent in the same period last year. Activity was briskly expanding in the technical services sector which grew 104 percent in the last nine months. The board approved the sale of 80 percent of Amper Elasa and 10 percent of Amper Datos to Germany's Siemens. The resolution of a labour conflict at Amper Telematica clears the way for Siemens to create Siemens Telecomunicaciones, a subsidiary which will take over Amper Telematica. The board also accepted the resignation of chairman Antonio Santillana del Barrio.
